description: Central Province - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1924/34 of 22.07.2015
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Hon. Marudapandi Rameshwaran) and provides detailed portfolio responsibilities (Minister of Agriculture, Minor Irrigation, Animal Production and Development, Agrarian Development, Fisheries, Environmental Affairs, Hindu Cultural and Estate Infrastructure Facilities of the Central Province). This combination of a named person with specific ministerial responsibilities qualifies it as a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
